overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the chair did not reasonably anticipate the two added items until June 20, fewer than 48 hours before the June 23 meeting, so they could be considered without listing.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the committee discussed and voted on items added to the June 23 agenda that were anticipated but not properly noticed.
allegations.key_passage: Because a public body may consider a topic that was not listed in the meeting notice if it was not anticipated 48 hours before the meeting, we find that there was no Open Meeting Law violation.
